jobs.title: Senior Solution Design Engineer - Energy
jobs.description:
Ready to find the right role for you?

**Salary:**Up to £65,000 with a total package up to £80,000 (Annual Bonus, Company Car/allowance) plus pension

**Location:** Home based with travel to Veolia sites


When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It’s why we’re looking for someone who’s just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.


We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.


As a Senior Solution Design Engineer, you will deliver conceptual and detailed design for energy systems including District Heating Networks, Energy Centres, HVAC, LTHW, Chilled Water, Heat Pumps (Air/Water/Geothermal Source), Low Carbon Heat Networks, Steam, and CHP.

 **What we can offer you;**

* Access to our company pension scheme
* Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
* Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
* 24 hour access to a virtual GP, 365 days a year, for you and family members in your household
* One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
* Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential

 **What you'll be doing;**

* Design diverse energy systems including district heating, energy centres, HVAC, heat pumps, CHP, and low\-carbon networks.
* Conduct energy audits, identify efficiency improvements, and deploy innovative technologies to achieve net\-zero targets.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical designs, P\&IDs, plant specifications, and integrated engineering solutions.
* Drive business development as Technical Lead from concept through proposal submission to construction handover.
* Deliver compelling client presentations showcasing technical capabilities and innovative solutions to complex challenges.
* Develop tender packages, manage approvals, and make critical decisions on project viability.
* Partner with clients to create resilient energy solutions delivering carbon reduction and cost savings across project lifecycles.
* Build strategic supplier relationships, manage project risks, and ensure robust contractual protection with partners.
* Champion innovation and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical excellence and creative problem\-solving.

**What we're looking for;**

* Educated to degree level within Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience designing energy systems.
* Experience working within the energy industry.
* Strong organisational and time management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of fostering teamwork and engaging constructively with clients.
* Familiarity with large\-scale thermal generating plants such as large shell \& tube boilers and CHP engines is essential.
* Experience with Heat Pump systems and renewables.
* AutoCAD experience.
* UK Driving Licence.

**What’s next?**


Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.


We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025\. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.


We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long\-term condition who opt\-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.


We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

jobs.description:
We gebruiken technologie om problemen op te lossen in ruimtes, licht en meer dingen die komen gaan ... voor onze klanten, onze gemeenschappen en onze planeet.

Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) is een toonaangevend industrieel technologiebedrijf. We gebruiken technologie om problemen op te lossen in ruimtes, licht en meer dingen die komen gaan. Via onze twee bedrijfssegmenten, Acuity Brands Lighting and Lighting Controls (ABL) en de Intelligent Spaces Group (ISG), ontwerpen, produceren en brengen we producten en diensten op de markt die een waardevol verschil maken in het leven van mensen.

We bevinden ons op het snijvlak van duurzaamheid en technologie. Onze bedrijven ontwikkelen technologie die onze klanten helpt energie te besparen en hun koolstofuitstoot te verminderen. We realiseren groei door de ontwikkeling van innovatieve nieuwe producten en diensten, waaronder verlichting, lichtregelingen, oplossingen voor gebouwbeheer en locatiebewuste toepassingen.

Job Summary

Light is our passion!
eldoLED is a world leader in the design and manufacture of intelligent drive solutions for LED based lighting systems. Our technologies empower our customers to deliver the promise of LED lighting: smarter, sleeker, and more efficient, meeting the needs of an ever more energy conscious world. eldoLED is part of Acuity Brands, a North American market leader and one of the world's leading providers of lighting solutions.

As the world of lighting turns to smart lighting and IoT applications, the driver is the heart of this technology revolution in the industry. New product development, sustaining of the continuously growing product portfolio and securing the leadership position with the creation of new technology are the three main challenges the development team faces. We are looking for a manager software engineering with scrum master and product owner responsibilities that loves to work in this challenging environment.

Job Description

Our products, your drive!
The eldoLED software team designs, implements and maintains a suite of software tools. These include backend services and supporting frontend applications developed in .NET Core and ReactJS respectively, enabling the design, configuration, testing, production and end-user interaction with our LED drivers and connected peripheral devices.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities (Essential Functions)

You will take a lead role in designing and building scalable systems and services, with a strong focus on performance, maintainability, and system capacity as well as nurture and grow the team.

Projects Now Include

Backend - .NET Core C#
Frontend - ReactJS
REST APIs
MQTT broker integration - .NET Core C#
Desktop application (Windows) - .NET Core C#

You!

Lead the team in agile development using Azure Dev-ops.
Mature and maintain build environments, document processes, and testing strategies.
Perform daily scrum master role.
Empower people and make sure team spirit is always high, even or especially when the pressure is on!
Love to contribute to bringing our technologies, our products & our platforms to the next generation.
Keep an open eye for new technology developments in the market & introducing innovative/new technologies in our products and processes.
Serve as the technical conscience for the SW team weighing customer ask and timeline against execution excellence, testability, and maintainability.
Think outside the box and into the future for architecture and feature definition.
Enjoys working with global support teams located in 4 countries.

Skills And Minimum Experience Required

Minimum of a master’s degree in computer science or equivalent by experience.
Minimum of 8 years Agile firmware development experience.
Strong experience in React JS, C#, .NET Core and object-oriented design principles
Proven experience designing and building scalable systems
Experience with REST API design and development
Strong experience with relational database design and modeling
Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth / OpenID)
Solid understanding of system performance, scalability and capacity evaluation
Experience in a variety of programming languages both low/high level
Eager learner (Acuity PDS processes) with a hands-on and challenging attitude.
Pro-active result-oriented team player with leadership skills empowering teammates, able to act as sounding board.
Strong communication skills in English, Dutch brings an advantage.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience with MQTT brokers (e.g. EMQX)
Experience with C# frontend technologies (e.g. Blazor, Avalonia UI)
Experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g. NUnit)

Jouw rol in ons team

Als virtualisatie engineer werk je binnen een team van enthousiaste specialisten aan de hoog beschikbare infrastructuren (zowel de traditionele als in de Cloud) van onze klanten. Je draagt bij aan klant-specifieke oplossingen binnen complexe omgevingen en werkt mee aan transitie- en transformatieprojecten. Klantgerichtheid en samenwerking met klanten staan centraal binnen dit team.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het standaardiseren en automatiseren van veel voorkomende werkzaamheden. Je documenteert je werkzaamheden, bereidt wijzigingen voor en houdt documentatie up-to-date. Je analyseert en lost zowel 1e als 2e lijn storingen op (met doorgroei naar 3e lijns), voert updates uit en zorgt voor life-cycle management. Je implementeert en configureert wijzigingen binnen de totale spectrum van de klantinfrastructuren , Virtualisatie (VMware/HyperV), security, scripting (PowerShell, Python, terraform) etc .

Ook het realiseren van projecten om de klant infrastructuren continu aan te laten sluiten bij de ontwikkelingen in de organisatie behoort tot je werkzaamheden.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Technische Vaardigheid in Virtualisatietechnologieën :

technische vaardigheid is van het grootste belang voor Virtualization Engineers. Deze vaardigheid omvat een diepgaand begrip van verschillende virtualisatieplatformen zoals VMware, Hyper-V en KVM. Het houdt in dat men in staat is om virtuele omgevingen te ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren, met een focus op optimale prestaties en schaalbaarheid. Het beheersen van deze vaardigheid betekent ook dat men complexe problemen kan oplossen en de integriteit van virtuele infrastructuren kan behouden.

Netwerk- en Beveiligingsexpertise :

een stevige kennis van netwerk- en beveiligingsprincipes is cruciaal voor Virtualization Engineers. Dit omvat kennis van netwerkconfiguratie, VLANs, firewalls en beveiligingsprotocollen. Het begrijpen van hoe virtuele omgevingen beveiligd kunnen worden tegen bedreigingen en kwetsbaarheden is essentieel. Netwerk- en beveiligingsexpertise maakt het mogelijk om robuuste, veilige en efficiënte virtuele netwerken te creëren die bedrijfsactiviteiten ondersteunen.

Automatisering en Scriptingvaardigheden :

automatisering is een sleutelcomponent in de rol van een Virtualization Engineer. Vaardigheden op dit gebied omvatten bekwaamheid in scripttalen zoals PowerShell, Python of Bash. Automatisering en scripting maken efficiënt beheer van virtuele omgevingen mogelijk, verminderen handmatige tussenkomst en minimaliseren fouten. Dit vaardigheidsgebied is essentieel voor het stroomlijnen van operaties en het verbeteren van de productiviteit.

Analytisch Vermogen en Probleemoplossend Denken :

virtualization Engineers moeten bedreven zijn in het analyseren van complexe systemen en het oplossen van ingewikkelde problemen. Dit omvat het diagnosticeren van prestatieproblemen, het optimaliseren van middelen en het waarborgen van systeemstabiliteit. Analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken stellen Virtualization Engineers in staat om een hoge beschikbaarheid en optimale prestaties van virtuele omgevingen te garanderen.

Projectmanagement en Samenwerking :

effectief projectmanagement en samenwerking zijn essentieel bij virtualisatieprojecten. Dit houdt in dat men virtualisatie-initiatieven plant, coördineert en uitvoert in nauwe samenwerking met multidisciplinaire teams. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, tijdmanagement en het vermogen om samen te werken zorgen ervoor dat projecten succesvol worden afgerond en aansluiten bij de organisatiedoelstellingen.

Continue Leren en Aanpassingsvermogen :

het virtualisatieveld evolueert voortdurend, waardoor continu leren en aanpassingsvermogen cruciale vaardigheden zijn. Op de hoogte blijven van de nieuwste trends, technologieën en best practices is essentieel om expertise te behouden. Aanpassingsvermogen stelt Virtualization Engineers in staat om snel te reageren op veranderingen en nieuwe oplossingen te integreren, zodat de virtuele infrastructuur modern en efficiënt blijft.

bij voorkeur ervaring met Agile werken
